title: semlayer --json error
description: The one object a semlayer command prints on stdout under --json when it refuses (exit 1) or fails in the tool itself (exit 2), beside its plain line on stderr. The MCP server returns the same object as structuredContent of a failed tool call.

error.description: The message, as the stderr line prints it after "semlayer <command>: ". Its words may change between releases.

code.description: Stable across releases. A bare word (user_error, usage, internal, no_layer, ...) for a refusal that is not a validate issue; family.name, registered in scripts/lib/issue-codes/, for one that is.

next.description: The command that fixes or explains the refusal, where there is one.
